sections.title: Species and crop forms
sections.text: Brassica rapa includes crop forms such as turnip, Chinese cabbage, pak choi, mizuna and some oilseed crops. The plate shows a flowering plant: depending on the form, plants reach roughly 1–1.5 m, while leaves and, in turnip forms, the swollen root are harvested.

sections.title: Food and comparison
sections.text: Turnip leaves and roots are eaten raw or cooked according to preparation; pak choi leaves are also eaten. B. rapa differs from B. oleracea in its crop groups and harvested organs, although their four-petalled yellow flowers look similar.
